Decision: the default rest wavelength when the user gives none. SGMeta.rest_wavelength is TWAVE, the window's reference wavelength, not a laboratory value. For Mg II k, TWAVE 2796.20 against laboratory 2796.35 Å shifts zero velocity by -16.1 km/s; for Si IV 1394 the shift is +4.3 km/s. Today WP2 (irispy moments default) and WP5 (irispy metadata) both fall back to TWAVE. Options: (a) default to the packaged line list's laboratory wavelength nearest TWAVE inside the window, showing the line name and source, with TWAVE as a labelled fallback ('window reference, not laboratory') (recommended); (b) keep TWAVE but label it as the window reference in the UI and docs; (c) no default: velocity and moments require an explicit rest wavelength. Whatever is chosen, WP2 and WP5 share one helper, and a test covers the Mg II k 16 km/s case.
